rule: (A) When: outdoors one roll per in-game hour; town one roll per in-game minute at night when no citizens are near; dungeons one roll per in-game minute unless camping; interiors one roll per minute even while camping; camping adds an hour roll; raised platform blocks; no roll while an enemy is already near; chance is a percent from the exe table (not in the box), 20 for building trespass, 25 on two holiday nights, index 13+ means none. (B) Level: working level = min(L+1, 20) + 0..3; folded bounded dice (peak at L); accept if r >= L/2, else trim to even and retry (net effect: draw from the upper half of [0,L]); new game level capped at 0..2; main quest floored at L minus 0..2; a level selects one of two groups by coin; a group is a record (count, id, level). (C) Where: per member, offset = signed 16-bit draw >> 6 (about -512..511 units), divided by 128 units per voxel (about -4..+3 voxels); only the player's tile is rejected (occupancy and floor checks commented out); 40 tries per radius, radius doubles; a member on a bad voxel is skipped, not retried; guard response 1-3 guards, first arrival plays Halt (violence) or StopThief (theft). (D) Camp: clock 13 game s per real s, camping x600 (one hour roll per 0.46 real s); an enemy near after rest shows a popup and clears the camp.
keep: Encounter as a record of count, id and level, so a group is one tiered threat
Level pick that clusters near the player with a fold and a small jitter
Two groups per level, one chosen by coin, so the same level varies in look
Gate: no new encounter while one is already near
Hour-based roll outdoors, minute-based roll indoors, so the place sets the pace
Camp as a fast-forward state with per-hour rolls, cut off by a message when enemies arrive
Guard response as a capped group (1 to 3) with a sound that depends on the crime
Spawns close enough to be felt, with a 40-try search per radius before expanding
